correctness.rationale: Exact proof verifies edgewise determinants, connected components of nonzero column supports, subspace-lattice Möbius inversion, and unique central subspace/graph-map lifts. Includes empty support, isolated vertices, zero and full dimensions, and characteristic two. The top stratum follows because each component contributes at most one to rank and the number of components is bounded by the independence number. A standalone independent RREF enumeration checks 158 vertex-space graph-field cases and 44 full-Lie-algebra cases; finite checks corroborate but do not replace the proof.

value.rationale: Subalgebra dimension zeta distributions are natural Lie-algebra invariants, and a single graph-uniform all-rank formula gives exact rational-point counts for an infinite class of two-step Lie algebras, including those with isolated vertices and all finite characteristics. The q-Gaussian central lift and Möbius change from constrained commuting tuples to Grassmannian points identify the full distribution, not only a known maximum dimension or a tiny special case. The exact top multiplicity captures non-coordinate maximal abelian subspaces (e.g. P4 gives 2q+1), a distinction not visible from the ordinary independence number.
